title: Egypt Cement Company workers’ sit-in and work stoppage, Qusair area, Qena
duration_as_reported: About three weeks (S012); exact endpoints not stated.
location_as_reported: Egypt Cement Company (Qena), Qusair area, Qena Governorate.
continuation_assessment: Possible cross-month continuation into January 2023, not a January candidate. S012 says the sit-in/work stoppage began in December 2022 and lasted about three weeks. S014 search-result preview is a contemporaneous December 31 report lead; S015 preview refers to a parliamentary briefing request about the reported December 22 start. Neither search-only item verifies the January endpoint or physical turnout.
demands_as_reported: Stabilize employment contracts, provide incentives, pay cost-of-living and hazard allowances, apply the minimum wage, and address alleged factory corruption. The reported demands are directed at the company; an own-state policy target is not established.
limitations: No exact event end date or simultaneous site attendance is reported. The linked search-result leads were not opened. No state policy demand is established, and no event is assigned to January.
